summary: A mixed day led by retail strategy shifts and Reliance's bond push, with regulatory developments on social media and Adani settlements. Key focus: festive season pricing strategy and Reliance's $1 billion securitization ahead of RBI decisions.

bullets.text: Supreme Court directs Centre to consider framing rules regulating social media accounts of minors.
Four Adani group companies settle public shareholding violations case with Sebi; Adani Enterprises among them.
Reliance lines up second $1 billion bond sale in three weeks for securitization; second offering in three weeks.
Meesho Mall saw 89% of new-to-brand shoppers in FY26 come from smaller cities; Mamaearth, Plix each added 1M+ first-time buyers.
Retailers shifting festive strategy from price cuts to financing, product redesign, and exchange offers to preserve margins.
